summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The preinstall lifecycle script (package.json scripts.preinstall runs setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmod +x's the binary in a temp directory, then execFileSync's it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~720KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle whose contents are obfuscated with a large string/number lookup table (n7gIxM) and a rotate-shift decoder function (WV8StW), with hex-name identifiers throughout — its actual behavior is not human-readable from source. The advertised functionality of the package is a one-line dist/index.js re-export of Cypress selectors; the substantive work performed on install is the alien-runtime execution of the obfuscated bundle, not the Cypress helper. Package name is under the @servicetitan npm scope with a thin "Utils" description, inconsistent with an internal ServiceTitan tool. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer's machine via a freshly-downloaded second language runtime, evading Node-only static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
